---
title: "Analysis Dashboard"
subtitle: "Frequency, respondent coverage, weighted importance, and group comparisons — every number links back to its quotations."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-no-project-alert" class="alert alert-warning d-none">
<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> No active project selected. <a href="projects.html">Go to Projects</a> to create or open one.
</div>

<div id="tb-analysis-content" class="d-none">

<div class="grid gap-3 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3"><div class="tb-stat-card"><div class="tb-stat-value" id="tb-stat-sources">0</div><div class="tb-stat-label">Sources</div></div></div>
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3"><div class="tb-stat-card"><div class="tb-stat-value" id="tb-stat-respondents">0</div><div class="tb-stat-label">Respondents</div></div></div>
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3"><div class="tb-stat-card"><div class="tb-stat-value" id="tb-stat-codedrefs">0</div><div class="tb-stat-label">Coded References</div></div></div>
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3"><div class="tb-stat-card"><div class="tb-stat-value" id="tb-stat-themes">0</div><div class="tb-stat-label">Themes / Codes</div></div></div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-3 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:340px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Theme Frequency <button class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-frequency" data-name="theme-frequency" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="tb-panel-body"><canvas id="tb-chart-frequency"></canvas></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:340px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Weighted Theme Score (Total) <button class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-weighted" data-name="weighted-theme-score" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="tb-panel-body"><canvas id="tb-chart-weighted"></canvas></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-3 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:320px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Respondent Coverage (%) <button class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-coverage" data-name="respondent-coverage" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="tb-panel-body"><canvas id="tb-chart-coverage"></canvas></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-lg-6">
<div class="tb-panel" style="height:320px;">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Most Frequent Words (all text)</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body" id="tb-top-words">
<p class="text-muted small">No text yet.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-panel mb-4">
<div class="tb-panel-header">
Respondent × Theme Matrix
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;" id="tb-matrix-metric-select">
<option value="frequency">Frequency</option>
<option value="totalWeight">Total Weighted Score</option>
<option value="avgWeight">Average Weight</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body" style="overflow-x:auto;">
<table class="table table-sm tb-matrix-table" id="tb-matrix-table"></table>
<p class="text-muted small mb-0">Click any cell to see the underlying quotations.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-panel mb-4">
<div class="tb-panel-header">
Group Comparison
</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body">
<div class="grid gap-2 mb-3">
<div class="g-col-6">
<label class="form-label small">Compare respondents by</label>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="tb-compare-attribute-select"></select>
</div>
<div class="g-col-6">
<label class="form-label small">Theme / Code</label>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="tb-compare-theme-select"></select>
</div>
</div>
<div style="height:280px;"><canvas id="tb-chart-compare"></canvas></div>
<p class="text-muted small mb-0" id="tb-compare-empty"></p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-panel mb-4">
<div class="tb-panel-header">Theme Hierarchy</div>
<div class="tb-panel-body" id="tb-theme-hierarchy"></div>
</div>

</div>

<!-- Evidence modal -->
<div class="modal fade" id="tb-modal-evidence" tabindex="-1">
<div class="modal-dialog modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
<div class="modal-content">
<div class="modal-header"><h5 class="modal-title" id="tb-evidence-title">Evidence</h5><button class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button></div>
<div class="modal-body" id="tb-evidence-list"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  if (window.TB && window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();
  var TB = window.TB;
  var project = TB.getActiveProject();
  if (!project) { document.getElementById("tb-no-project-alert").classList.remove("d-none"); return; }
  document.getElementById("tb-analysis-content").classList.remove("d-none");

  function esc(s) { return TB.escapeHtml(s); }
  function leafThemes() {
    return project.themes.filter(function (t) { return TB.childThemes(project, t.id).length === 0; });
  }

  function showEvidence(title, list) {
    document.getElementById("tb-evidence-title").textContent = title;
    var body = document.getElementById("tb-evidence-list");
    body.innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(function (e) {
      return '<div class="tb-evidence-quote">' +
        "&ldquo;" + esc(e.quote) + "&rdquo;" +
        '<div class="text-muted small mt-1">' + esc(e.sourceName) + (e.respondentLabel ? " — " + esc(e.respondentLabel) : "") +
        (e.weight !== null && e.weight !== undefined ? ' &nbsp;<span class="badge bg-secondary">weight ' + e.weight + "/10</span>" : "") +
        (e.memo ? " — <em>" + esc(e.memo) + "</em>" : "") + "</div></div>";
    }).join("") : '<p class="text-muted">No coded references yet.</p>';
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("tb-modal-evidence")).show();
  }
  function showThemeEvidence(themeId) {
    var theme = TB.themeById(project, themeId);
    showEvidence(theme ? theme.name : "Evidence", TB.evidenceForTheme(project, themeId));
  }

  function renderSummary() {
    document.getElementById("tb-stat-sources").textContent = project.sources.length;
    document.getElementById("tb-stat-respondents").textContent = TB.respondentsOf(project).length;
    document.getElementById("tb-stat-codedrefs").textContent = project.codings.length;
    document.getElementById("tb-stat-themes").textContent = project.themes.length;
  }

  function renderMainCharts() {
    var leaves = leafThemes();
    var stats = leaves.map(function (t) { var s = TB.themeStats(project, t.id); s.theme = t; return s; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.frequency - a.frequency; });
    var labels = stats.map(function (s) { return s.theme.name; });
    var colors = stats.map(function (s) { return s.theme.color; });

    TB.charts.barChart("tb-chart-frequency", labels, stats.map(function (s) { return s.frequency; }), {
      label: "Frequency", colors: colors,
      onClick: function (i) { showThemeEvidence(stats[i].theme.id); }
    });
    var byWeight = stats.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.totalWeight - a.totalWeight; });
    TB.charts.barChart("tb-chart-weighted", byWeight.map(function (s) { return s.theme.name; }), byWeight.map(function (s) { return s.totalWeight; }), {
      label: "Total Weighted Score", colors: byWeight.map(function (s) { return s.theme.color; }),
      onClick: function (i) { showThemeEvidence(byWeight[i].theme.id); }
    });
    TB.charts.barChart("tb-chart-coverage", labels, stats.map(function (s) { return s.coveragePct; }), {
      label: "Respondent Coverage %", colors: colors, horizontal: true,
      onClick: function (i) { showThemeEvidence(stats[i].theme.id); }
    });
  }

  function renderTopWords() {
    var words = TB.wordFrequency(project, { scope: "all" }).slice(0, 14);
    var el = document.getElementById("tb-top-words");
    if (!words.length) { el.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">No text yet.</p>'; return; }
    var max = words[0].count;
    el.innerHTML = words.map(function (w) {
      var size = 0.8 + (w.count / max) * 0.9;
      return '<span class="badge rounded-pill bg-light text-dark border me-2 mb-2" style="font-size:' + size.toFixed(2) + 'rem;">' + esc(w.word) + " · " + w.count + "</span>";
    }).join("") + '<p class="text-muted small mt-2 mb-0">See the <a href="wordfrequency.html">Word Frequency &amp; Word Cloud</a> page for the full picture.</p>';
  }

  function renderMatrix() {
    var metric = document.getElementById("tb-matrix-metric-select").value;
    var m = TB.matrixData(project, leafThemes().map(function (t) { return t.id; }));
    var cellValue = function (r, t) {
      var c = m.cells[r.id][t.id];
      if (metric === "avgWeight") return c.weightedCount ? Math.round((c.totalWeight / c.weightedCount) * 100) / 100 : null;
      if (metric === "totalWeight") return c.totalWeight;
      return c.frequency;
    };
    var max = 0;
    m.respondents.forEach(function (r) { m.themes.forEach(function (t) { max = Math.max(max, cellValue(r, t) || 0); }); });

    var html = "<thead><tr><th>Respondent</th>" + m.themes.map(function (t) { return "<th>" + esc(t.name) + "</th>"; }).join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    html += m.respondents.map(function (r) {
      return "<tr><th class=\"text-nowrap\">" + esc(r.label) + "</th>" + m.themes.map(function (t) {
        var v = cellValue(r, t);
        var display = v === null ? "—" : v;
        var bg = TB.charts.heatColor(v || 0, max);
        var fg = TB.charts.heatTextColor(v || 0, max);
        return '<td class="tb-cell-heat" style="background:' + bg + ";color:" + fg + ';" data-respondent="' + r.id + '" data-theme="' + t.id + '">' + display + "</td>";
      }).join("") + "</tr>";
    }).join("");
    html += "</tbody>";
    var table = document.getElementById("tb-matrix-table");
    table.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(table.querySelectorAll(".tb-cell-heat"), function (td) {
      td.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var rid = td.getAttribute("data-respondent"), tid = td.getAttribute("data-theme");
        var r = m.respondents.find(function (r) { return r.id === rid; });
        var theme = TB.themeById(project, tid);
        var evidence = TB.evidenceForTheme(project, tid).filter(function (e) { return TB.respondentIdForCoding(e.coding) === rid; });
        showEvidence((theme ? theme.name : "") + " — " + (r ? r.label : ""), evidence);
      });
    });
  }

  var ATTRIBUTE_LABELS = { sex: "Sex", location: "Location", stakeholder: "Stakeholder", institution: "Institution" };
  function comparableAttributes() {
    var respondents = TB.respondentsOf(project);
    return Object.keys(ATTRIBUTE_LABELS).filter(function (key) {
      var values = {};
      respondents.forEach(function (r) { var v = (r.attributes || {})[key]; if (v) values[v] = true; });
      return Object.keys(values).length > 1;
    });
  }

  function renderCompareControls() {
    var attrs = comparableAttributes();
    var attrSelect = document.getElementById("tb-compare-attribute-select");
    var emptyMsg = document.getElementById("tb-compare-empty");
    if (!attrs.length) {
      attrSelect.innerHTML = "";
      emptyMsg.textContent = "Add at least two respondents with different Sex/Location/Stakeholder/Institution values to compare groups.";
      TB.charts.destroy("tb-chart-compare");
      return;
    }
    emptyMsg.textContent = "";
    attrSelect.innerHTML = attrs.map(function (a) { return '<option value="' + a + '">' + ATTRIBUTE_LABELS[a] + "</option>"; }).join("");
    var themeSelect = document.getElementById("tb-compare-theme-select");
    themeSelect.innerHTML = leafThemes().map(function (t) { return '<option value="' + t.id + '">' + esc(t.name) + "</option>"; }).join("");
    renderCompareChart();
  }

  function renderCompareChart() {
    var attrs = comparableAttributes();
    if (!attrs.length) return;
    var attrKey = document.getElementById("tb-compare-attribute-select").value;
    var themeId = document.getElementById("tb-compare-theme-select").value;
    if (!attrKey || !themeId) return;
    var groups = TB.groupComparison(project, attrKey, themeId);
    TB.charts.groupedBarChart("tb-chart-compare", groups.map(function (g) { return g.value; }), [
      { name: "Frequency", values: groups.map(function (g) { return g.frequency; }), color: "#4B2E83" },
      { name: "Coverage %", values: groups.map(function (g) { return g.coveragePct; }), color: "#17B8A6" }
    ]);
  }

  function renderHierarchy() {
    var tree = TB.themeTree(project);
    function renderNode(node, depth) {
      var s = TB.themeStats(project, node.id);
      return '<div class="tb-theme-row" style="margin-left:' + (depth * 1.1) + 'rem;" data-theme-id="' + node.id + '">' +
        '<span class="tb-theme-swatch" style="background:' + node.color + ';"></span>' +
        '<span class="flex-grow-1">' + esc(node.name) + "</span>" +
        '<span class="text-muted small me-2">cov. ' + s.coverageCount + "/" + s.coverageTotal + "</span>" +
        '<span class="badge bg-light text-dark border">' + s.frequency + "×</span>" +
        (s.avgWeight !== null ? ' <span class="badge bg-accent ms-1">avg ' + s.avgWeight + "</span>" : "") +
        "</div>" +
        node.children.map(function (c) { return renderNode(c, depth + 1); }).join("");
    }
    var el = document.getElementById("tb-theme-hierarchy");
    el.innerHTML = tree.length ? tree.map(function (n) { return renderNode(n, 0); }).join("") : '<p class="text-muted small mb-0">No themes yet — add some from the Coding Workspace.</p>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll(".tb-theme-row"), function (row) {
      row.addEventListener("click", function () { showThemeEvidence(row.getAttribute("data-theme-id")); });
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("tb-matrix-metric-select").addEventListener("change", renderMatrix);
  document.getElementById("tb-compare-attribute-select").addEventListener("change", renderCompareChart);
  document.getElementById("tb-compare-theme-select").addEventListener("change", renderCompareChart);

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-png]"), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      TB.exportUtil.canvasToPNG(btn.getAttribute("data-png"), TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title) + "-" + btn.getAttribute("data-name") + ".png");
    });
  });

  renderSummary();
  renderMainCharts();
  renderTopWords();
  renderMatrix();
  renderCompareControls();
  renderHierarchy();
});
</script>
```
